invariants.rationale: Method always returns a new HoodieWriteMetadata object as 'result', so it is non-null.
By construction, result stores a List<WriteStatus> as its payload.
The 'writeStatuses' list is always created and added before returning 'result'.
inputRecords is used without a null check; method expects it to be non-null.
A List's size cannot be negative, so this invariant always holds.
